g.text: Arm 2 recovers about 80% of injected solar; a cloud-driven load adds 20%

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'One dot per Primary, season-year 2024/25, injection at 100% of the pinned capacity. Recovery is the same at 20% and 50%. The cloud-driven load is a day-long demand that rises on overcast days, of 10% of the injected capacity, which the fit partly reads as solar.'
text.tspan: One dot per Primary, season-year 2024/25, injection at 100% of the pinned capacity. Recovery is the
same at 20% and 50%. The cloud-driven load is a day-long demand that rises on overcast days, of 10%
of the injected capacity, which the fit partly reads as solar.
